whatItDoes.text: Scope: Read-only observation and recovery acceptance criteria. This README update does not change trading authorization, deploy application code, or generate execution evidence.

requirements.text: Every account requires both files; empty/ambiguous scopes, duplicate symbols, untrusted basis, symlinks, destination collisions, path/environment mixups and checksum/file-set differences fail closed.
It requires current data, direction/borrow eligibility, costs and holdout evidence, rejects unsupported global markets and never submits orders, sizes positions or authorizes trading.
A brokerage must not be able to accidentally execute, halt, mutate, or account for another brokerage's trading state.

PR #2891 wired paid customers into the canonical multi-account runtime only when authoritative billing, consent, risk acknowledgement, mode, supported broker credentials, and encrypted-vault checks pass.
